style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: the direct command to become a yogi
candidates.evidence: तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन (therefore, become a yogi, Arjuna)

candidates.angle: the ranking of the yogi above all three types of people
candidates.evidence: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः (the yogi is greater than ascetics, greater than scholars)

candidates.angle: the word 'yogi' is repeated three times to build a hierarchy
candidates.evidence: योगी (the yogi) ... योगी (the yogi) ... योगी (a yogi)

angle_en: The direct command to become a yogi

en.intro: Krishna has just shown how a yogi's practice survives failure. Now he ranks the yogi above all other paths and gives a direct command.
en.notice: Listen to the rhythm of the word yogi. It is named three times, each time placed higher than the last, and the verse ends with a direct order to Arjuna to become one.
en.next: Krishna now names the one who worships him with trust and complete absorption.
en.meaning: The yogi is greater than ascetics, greater than scholars, and greater than workers. Therefore, Arjuna, become a yogi.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने पहले बताया था कि योग का अभ्यास कैसे सफल होता है। अब वे योग को सबसे ऊँचा बताते हैं और अर्जुन को सीधा आदेश देते हैं।
hi.meaning: योगी तपस्वियोंसे श्रेष्ठ है, ज्ञानियोंसे भी श्रेष्ठ है और कर्मियोंसे भी श्रेष्ठ है। अतः हे अर्जुन, तुम योगी बनो।
hi.notice: इस श्लोक में 'योगी' शब्द को तीन बार दोहराया गया है, हर बार उसे तपस्वियों, ज्ञानियों और कर्मियों से ऊँचा रखा गया है, और अंत में अर्जुन को सीधा आदेश दिया गया है कि वे योगी बनें।
hi.next: अब कृष्ण उस भक्त का वर्णन करते हैं जो पूर्ण विश्वास और एकाग्रता से उनकी पूजा करता है।

en.intro: Krishna has just shown how a yogi's practice survives failure. Now he ranks the yogi above all other paths and gives a direct command.
en.body: The yogi is greater than ascetics, greater than scholars, and greater than workers. Therefore, Arjuna, become a yogi. Listen to the rhythm of the word yogi. It is named three times, each time placed higher than the last, and the verse ends with a direct order to Arjuna to become one. Krishna now names the one who worships him with trust and complete absorption.

issues: meaning_changed: "सकाम भाववाले तपस्वियोंसे भी योगी श्रेष्ठ है" (The Hindi translation adds the qualifier 'सकाम भाववाले' (with desire for results) to the ascetics, which is not present in the Sanskrit source 'तपस्विभ्योऽधिकः'. The source simply states the yogi is greater than ascetics.)
